doc.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997

title: Advice to young saxophonists
summary: Practice scales, expect rejection and keep spirits high.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Any last words of wisdom for the typical saxophone student who says man, I’m going to be a jazz musician?

Well I would tell him to practice and learn his scales, and to be in for rejection the same as actors have to go through, all the successful actors and actresses, and whatever. People that deal with rejection in life, you have to learn to accept it. But you still have to practice
your craft, whatever you do. And being for that, just keep your spirits high. That’s my best advice.
